ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Regsvr32 Execution From Remote Share
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects REGSVR32.exe to execute DLL hosted on remote shares

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "\\REGSVR32\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*"))
